name: table-team-projects
title: Projects with team avatars
description: Projects with team avatars. MDX/Table pattern composed from @gaudi/design-system/mdx/Table and other public Gaudi components; the components stay package imports.
docs: Copy-in pattern built on @gaudi/design-system; the components stay package imports. Load '@gaudi/design-system/global.css' once and add transpilePackages: ['@gaudi/design-system'] in Next.js. Until the package is on npm, install it from GitHub first: pnpm add github:ahmadassaf/design-system. Demo assets referenced (supply your own or copy them into public/): /avatars/person-19.svg, /avatars/person-20.svg, /avatars/person-23.svg, /avatars/person-25.svg, /avatars/person-38.svg, /avatars/person-41.svg, /avatars/person-43.svg, /avatars/person-47.svg.
